name: 'Python recursion'
description: 'Use when writing or modifying Python functions.'
applyTo: '**/*.py'
---
# Python recursion

* Always use a recursive function when a problem can be solved recursively, such as tree traversal, factorials, Fibonacci, or processing nested data.
* Do not use a loop when a recursive solution is available.
* Every recursive function must have a clear base case.
* When refactoring existing Python code, convert loops to recursion where a recursive solution is available.
